senses.gloss: tenant on a fixed rent payable in kind, v. אָרִיס II.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:9:3">Y. Bicc. I, end, 64ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ לשעה</he> a tenant for a fixed term, <he>ח׳ לעולם</he> a permanent tenant (on ground rent).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104a:3">B. Mets. 104ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="H00318"><he>חוֹכֵר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲכִירִין</he>, <he>חֲכוּ׳</he>, <cite ref="H00934"><he>חֲכִירוֹת</he></cite>, (<he>חוֹכְרִין</he>) <cite ref="H00934"><he>חֲכוּרוֹת</he></cite>. Y. Bicc. l. c. <he>חֲכוּרֵי בתי אבות</he> hereditary tenants.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 2:11">Ter. II, 11</cite> <he>חוכרין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="H00934"><he>חכורות</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00934"><he>חכירות</he></cite>). Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵇ bot. <he>חֲכִירָיו</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:2">B. Mets. IX, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 103b:13">103ᵇ</cite>) <he>מנכה לו מן חֲכִירוֹ</he> Talm. ed. (Mish. <he>חֲכוּ׳</he>) he deducts from the stipulated rent (in proportion). Ib. 4 (105ᵃ) <he>הואיל ואני נותן לך חֲכִירְךָ</he> (Y. ed. <he>חֲכוּרְךָ</he>, Mish. <he>חֲכוּרָהּ</he>) as long as I give thee thy rent (Mish.: the rent for it).
